prompt: Break this work down into tickets our developers can pick up. First look at the codebase, then give me the tickets.
spec: Feature: customer tags (labels a support agent can attach to a customer).
Phase 1 — database: add a tags table and a customer_tags join table, with migrations.
Phase 2 — backend: CRUD endpoints for tags and endpoints to attach/detach a tag to a customer.
Phase 3 — frontend: tag chips on the customer detail page with an autocomplete picker.
Please create one ticket per phase.

expect.check: every ticket says what can be demonstrated when it is done
tickets are cut vertically despite the spec asking for one ticket per layer; the output does not simply mirror phase 1/2/3
the deviation from the requested per-layer split is named and explained to the requester
the first ticket delivers one demonstrable slice (for example: attach an existing tag and see it on the customer)
